author: reek
body: The repro for builtin shadowing. abs is a builtin; this chapter defines one too, and until CDX3005 existed nothing said so at any severity.

author: reek
body: Here the definition wins: the printed value is 94 and not 4. That is the point of printing it -- the assertion this test exists for is the diagnostic, but a diagnostic about a shadow that did not actually shadow anything would be worth nothing, so the runtime line proves the warning is about a real substitution.
